task_completion.description: Agent opens System Advisor Model (SAM) and selects 'Molten Salt Power Tower' for a 'Single Owner' or 'Utility Scale' project.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Screenshot showing the SAM start screen with 'Molten Salt Power Tower' selected and the main configuration interface open.

task_completion.description: Agent sets the location to Phoenix, AZ and downloads/selects the appropriate weather file.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Location and Resource' page in SAM showing 'Phoenix, AZ' selected in the library or map.

task_completion.description: Agent configures the system for 'Evaporative' (wet) cooling and runs the simulation to obtain annual energy and water data.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Condenser' or 'System Design' page showing 'Evaporative' selected, followed by a 'Results' page showing annual energy production and water usage.

task_completion.description: Agent switches the cooling configuration to 'Air-cooled' (dry) and re-runs the simulation.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Condenser' page showing 'Air-cooled' selected and a new set of results generated in the SAM interface.

task_completion.description: Agent calculates the energy penalty percentage and water savings based on the two simulation runs.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A calculator, scratchpad, or terminal window where the agent performs (Wet Energy - Dry Energy) / Wet Energy and (Wet Water - Dry Water).

task_completion.description: Agent saves the comparative analysis to /home/ga/Documents/SAM_Projects/cooling_comparison.json with all required keys.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A text editor or terminal 'cat' command showing the final JSON file with the correct path, keys, and values matching the SAM results.

integrity.description: Verify the agent used the SAM GUI to perform simulations rather than hardcoding values.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots must show the agent clicking buttons, navigating tabs, and viewing the 'Results' summary within the SAM application.

integrity.description: Ensure the energy and water values in the JSON match the values displayed in the SAM results UI.
integrity.visual_evidence: Side-by-side comparison of the SAM 'Results' dashboard values and the final JSON content.

integrity.description: Check that the agent didn't simply create the JSON file immediately without opening the SAM software.
integrity.visual_evidence: The trajectory must show the progression of opening SAM, configuring parameters, and running simulations before the file is saved.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The simulation must be for a Molten Salt Power Tower in Phoenix, AZ. Expected physical trends: Wet cooling annual energy must be higher than dry cooling annual energy (typically > 10 GWh difference for 100MW). Wet cooling water usage must be significantly higher (often > 5x) than dry cooling water usage. The energy_penalty_percent is calculated as ((Wet_Energy - Dry_Energy) / Wet_Energy) * 100. The water_savings_m3 is (Wet_Water - Dry_Water). The output file must be exactly /home/ga/Documents/SAM_Projects/cooling_comparison.json.
